coaching.title: Today's Run
coaching.message: Easy 5–6 miles, Z2 (130–140 bpm), rolling terrain but nothing steep. You're 42 days out in hard taper; volume is down 21% this week and that's correct. Your last three runs average 141 bpm, which means you're either running hard on 'easy' days or your aerobic baseline has drifted up—either way, dial it back today. This is a shakeout before tomorrow's long run; treat it as a prime mover for blood flow and CNS activation, not a fitness stimulus. Keep it under 60 minutes total.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You're carrying a sleep debt: 6.31 hours last night vs. your 30-day average of 8.33 hours. That 2-hour shortfall is real, and it taxes glycogen and cortisol recovery. Eat 1.2–1.5g carbs per kg body weight today (roughly 90–120g if you're ~75kg), distributed across breakfast, lunch, snack, and dinner—no skipping. Prioritize simple carbs at breakfast and post-run (banana + rice cakes or pasta) to replenish what sleep didn't protect. Hydrate to urine color: pale yellow is your target.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Your resting HR dropped 8 bpm below your 30-day average (57 vs. 65), which is a good sign of readiness—but sleep was short and that blunts adaptation. Tonight: aim for 8–9 hours. No screens after 21:30, room temp 65–68°F, blackout curtains. If you're traveling for work, prioritize sleep over evening meetings; the 50K doesn't care about a call. Your 71/100 recovery score is solid, but cumulative sleep debt in taper kills race-day power.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: You're in the hardest phase mentally—taper anxiety hits endurance athletes hard, and the temptation to squeeze in 'one more hard workout' is real. Resist it. Your fitness is locked in; the next 42 days are about managing fatigue, staying sharp, and arriving at the start line fresh. Tomorrow's long run will feel easy and that's the point. Trust the plan. The Julian Alps will have enough vert and altitude to humble you; your job now is to show up recovered, not broken.
